propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 that searches the tracker for duplicate reports before Phase 1, causing duplicate filings to go undetected across 759 closed bug tickets

The reported-against version floor cannot be derived from a nonexistent rebar-version ticket field; it must be computed from report text or converted from the ticket's nanosecond created_at timestamp via integer division by 1e9 and passed to git --before= in unix-seconds form

The nanosecond-to-seconds conversion is currently broken in the documented floor derivation (raw nanoseconds passed to git --before= silently returns the tip), requiring explicit statement of the divisor and @<unix-seconds> syntax
Step 0 must perform an unfiltered tracker sweep including closed tickets and check worktree currency against origin/main before proceeding to Phase 1 on both full and fast paths
The Step-0 duplicates link action requires pre-approval in the approval-gate carve-out list to avoid gating its own action behind user approval
